usernames.title: Usernames
usernames.description: Handles to scrape, with or without the leading `@`. Full profile URLs are accepted too.

directUrls.title: Profile URLs
directUrls.description: Instagram profile URLs — merged with the list above and de-duplicated.

sessionCookie.title: Session cookie (sessionid)
sessionCookie.description:
Value of the `sessionid` cookie from a logged-in browser. Logged-out access to this endpoint is heavily restricted, so without it most profiles return nothing.

**The account whose cookie you use is the account that gets flagged.** Use a throwaway, never your main one.

enrichFromWebsite.title: Follow bio links to find e-mails
enrichFromWebsite.description: Most accounts never fill in the public business e-mail but do link to a site that lists one. Following that link does not touch Instagram's rate limit, so this is where most of the yield comes from.

maxWebsitePagesPerProfile.title: Max website pages per profile
maxWebsitePagesPerProfile.description: Landing page included. If it holds no address, the usual contact pages (`/contact`, `/kontakt`, `/impressum`, …) are tried next. Link-in-bio hubs like Linktree are expanded into their outbound links instead.

emailDomainBlocklist.title: Ignored e-mail domains
emailDomainBlocklist.description: Added to the built-in list of tracker and placeholder domains. An entry blocks its subdomains too.

onlyWithEmail.title: Only save profiles that have an e-mail
onlyWithEmail.description: Keeps the dataset to usable leads. Turn it off when you want the profile data regardless.

verifyEmailDomains.title: Verify addresses (MX + classification)
verifyEmailDomains.description: One cached DNS query per domain. Adds `emailDetails` to every profile: whether the domain accepts mail at all, and whether the address is a role account (`info@`), a free-mail box (`gmail.com`) or a disposable one.

dropUndeliverable.title: Drop addresses whose domain has no mail server
dropUndeliverable.description: Removes them from `emails` instead of only labelling them. Disposable providers are always dropped when verification is on.

dropRoleAccounts.title: Drop role accounts
dropRoleAccounts.description: Removes `info@`, `office@`, `prodaja@` and similar. Off by default: for small businesses that is very often the only published address.

requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between profiles (s)
requestDelaySecs.description: Instagram's limiter is a sliding window, so this does not raise the ceiling — it spreads the run out so a block arrives later and recovers cleanly. Below ~10 s you will hit the wall quickly.
requestDelaySecs.sectionDescription: The endpoint allows roughly 20 profiles per 30 minutes per IP. These settings decide how the run behaves when that limit is reached.

rateLimitBackoffMins.title: Backoff after a block (min)
rateLimitBackoffMins.description: How long to sit still after a 401/429. The observed window is about 29 minutes.

maxRateLimitRetries.title: Retries after a block
maxRateLimitRetries.description: How many times to wait-and-retry a single profile before writing it off.

stopAfterConsecutiveFailures.title: Stop after N failures in a row
stopAfterConsecutiveFailures.description: A run of failures means the IP is blocked or the session died. Stopping preserves the rest of your list for a later attempt.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: The only way past the per-IP limit. Residential proxies work; datacenter ranges are largely burned on Instagram. Leave empty to run from your own IP.
